what: Two-date composite covering the canonical AOI with no blank area.

gapFilled.reason: The 1947 county flight did not photograph the north-west quarter of the AOI. Verified: the two other 1947 rasters intersecting the AOI (oid 286 San Juan Capistrano 600 Scale 1947, oid 289 Laguna Beach-Dana Point 600 Scale 1947) do not reach it either - mosaicking all three left the same 32.9% gap.

toneMatch: Linear mean/std match applied to the 1938 fill region only, so the seam does not read as a cliff. Cosmetic; no pixel values were invented and no feature was added or removed.
displayRule: The frame must state on its face that the north-west quarter is 1938, not 1947. A composite may never be presented as a single-date photograph.
source: OC Survey / OCGIS Historic_Imagery_v2 ImageServer, LockRaster exports
